content_sections.heading: About CHTI Administrative Officer Post
content_sections.text: The Central Hindi Training Institute in New Delhi is a subordinate office of the Department of Official Language, Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India. The Administrative Officer assists the Head of Department of the institute in the administrative, establishment, financial and vigilance work of the institute and the Hindi Teaching Scheme (Hindi Shikshan Yojana). The office memorandum was issued by the Department of Official Language, 4th Floor, NDCC-2 Building, Jai Singh Road, Near Jantar Mantar, New Delhi-110001, and is signed by Moushmi Tirkey, Under Secretary to the Government of India.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The office memorandum asks that applications of suitable, willing and eligible officers who can be relieved immediately be sent through proper channel to the undersigned, with the documents listed under Enclosures. The undersigned is the Under Secretary, Department of Official Language, Ministry of Home Affairs, 4th Floor, NDCC-2 Building, Jai Singh Road, Near Jantar Mantar, New Delhi-110001. Fill the application form (bio-data) given at Annexure-II of the notice, in two copies. Give personal details, educational qualifications, a period-wise employment record, the nature of present employment and pay drawn, as the proforma asks. State in item 17 of the form whether you are applying on deputation or re-employment basis. Sign the declaration that the information is true and that the Selection Committee will evaluate it. Get the certificate at the end of the form completed and countersigned, with seal, by your employer or cadre controlling authority. Forward the application with all enclosures through your office (proper channel) so that it reaches the undersigned by the last date for receipt. The notice does not mention what to write on the envelope or a specific postal mode.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post of Administrative Officer, classified as General Central Service, Group 'A' Gazetted, in Pay Matrix Level-11 (₹67,700-2,08,700). The pay of the selected officer will be regulated as per the Department of Personnel and Training Office Memorandum No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17 June 2010, as amended from time to time. Officers of the Central Government, State Governments or Union Territory Administrations: (a)(i) holding analogous posts on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (a)(ii) with five years' service in the grade rendered after appointment on a regular basis to posts in Level 10 of the Pay Matrix (₹56,100-1,77,500) or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; and (b)(i) holding a degree in any subject from a recognised university; and (b)(ii) having five years' experience in administration, establishment and accounts matters. Armed Forces personnel of the rank of Captain or equivalent who are due to retire or be transferred to reserve within one year, and who have the educational qualification and experience prescribed for deputationists, will also be considered. If selected, such an officer will be kept on deputation terms up to the date of release from the Armed Forces, and may thereafter be allowed to continue on re-employment. If such an eligible officer retires or is transferred to reserve before the actual selection, the appointment will be on re-employment basis (re-employment up to the age of superannuation with reference to civil posts). The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. The period of deputation, including the period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment in the same or some other organisation or department of the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed four years. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: CHTI Administrative Officer Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist the Head of Department, Central Hindi Training Institute, in disposing of all administrative, establishment, financial and vigilance matters of the institute and the Hindi Teaching Scheme. Dispose of parliamentary matters relating to the institute and the Hindi Teaching Scheme. Maintain the office of the Central Hindi Training Institute. Create posts and frame and amend recruitment rules for posts of the institute and the Hindi Teaching Scheme. Office management (housekeeping job). Prepare replies in cases against the Government in the Central Administrative Tribunal, High Court and Supreme Court, and assist the Government counsel. Act as Member Secretary in Departmental Promotion Committees for Group 'C'. Collect and prepare information sought under the Right to Information Act and ensure it is supplied on time. Ensure action in vigilance and disciplinary matters.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Complete ACR dossier of the applicant, or photocopies of the Annual Confidential Reports for the last five years (2020-21 to 2024-25), each page duly attested by a Group 'A' gazetted officer. Integrity certificate. Certificate that no disciplinary or vigilance case is pending against the officer and none is contemplated. Details of any minor or major penalty imposed on the officer during the last 10 years; if none, a "Nil" certificate. Cadre clearance (no objection) certificate for the applicant. For officers already on deputation: cadre clearance, vigilance clearance and integrity certificate from the parent cadre/department, which must forward the application. For applicants from organisations not following Central Government pay scales: the latest pay slip showing basic pay with scale and rate of increment, DA/interim relief/other allowances, and total emoluments. A separate sheet, signed by the applicant, if the space in the form is not enough.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: According to the declaration in the application form, the information in the applicant's bio-data, supported by documents on the essential qualification and work experience, will be evaluated by the Selection Committee at the time of selection. The notice does not describe any other stage.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CHTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Administrative Officer at the Central Hindi Training Institute, New Delhi, to be filled on deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CHTI Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: Applications must be received within 60 days of the issue of the office memorandum dated 29 October 2026 or its publication in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar, whichever is later - about 28 December 2026 if the Employment News publication is not later.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the CHTI Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: A degree in any subject from a recognised university and five years' experience in administration, establishment and accounts matters, along with holding an analogous post on a regular basis or five years' regular service in Pay Matrix Level 10 (₹56,100-1,77,500) or equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CHTI Administrative Officer deputation?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the CHTI Administrative Officer?
faq.answer: The post is in Pay Matrix Level-11 (₹67,700-2,08,700), and the selected officer's pay will be regulated as per DoPT OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17 June 2010, as amended.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the CHTI Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure-II proforma in two copies and send it with the required documents through proper channel to the Under Secretary, Department of Official Language, Ministry of Home Affairs, 4th Floor, NDCC-2 Building, Jai Singh Road, Near Jantar Mantar, New Delhi-110001.

faq.question: Q7. How will the CHTI Administrative Officer be selected?
faq.answer: The information in the bio-data, supported by documents on essential qualification and work experience, will be evaluated by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the deputation tenure for this post?
faq.answer: The deputation period, including any immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation in the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed four years.

faq.question: Q9. Can Armed Forces officers apply for the CHTI Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: Yes, Armed Forces personnel of the rank of Captain or equivalent due to retire or be transferred to reserve within one year, with the prescribed qualification and experience, will also be considered on deputation or re-employment terms.

faq.question: Q10. Can an applicant withdraw the application later?
faq.answer: No, officers who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their application later.
